data.body: Janitor skill design - three further rulings. (2) CONVERGENCE RULE UNCHANGED. The maintainer's rebuttal: the cited consensus research studies agreement across IDENTICAL inputs (sycophancy, peer pressure, modal adoption), whereas our proposers are blind to each other AND hold different evidence bases. Agreement across decorrelated inputs is triangulation, not conformity, so the conformity literature does not transfer. Accepted. (3) PRE-COMMITMENT REJECTED as a different shape from our process. Zhou's finding targets a judge asked for a holistic "is this right?" verdict on a candidate. Our verification decomposes into narrow binary sub-questions plus the citation veto plus harm-reachability, which already moves scoring from general impression to specific measurable facets - the same mechanism reached by another route. Accepted. (4) INTENT CHECK now also feeds SCORING, not just reporting. Surface the record, require the proposal to address it, pass the intent information through to the user for review - and apply a scoring penalty when a deliberate prior decision exists and the proposal does not name what evidence has changed. Effect is that a MARGINAL finding is dropped while a strong one survives contact with the record.
